test_diamond_inheritance: test diamond inheritance pattern where a D instance returns itself through c0, c1, and b accessor methods
test_disown_b: test that disowning a B instance via disown_b makes all Python references to it raise a disowned error
test_disown_c0: test that disowning the shared base B through either C0 or B reference invalidates both Python instances
test_disown_d: test that disowning the shared base B through any of D, C0, C1, or B invalidates all Python instances
test_multiple_inheritance_python: test multiple Python inheritance classes MI1 through MI8b that mix pybind11 C++ bases with pure Python bases
